rounds.hypothesis: Place the book upright at the center of the precomputed accepted origin region, rotated so its approximately 28 mm thickness crosses the narrow compartment dimension. The demonstrated grasp should stabilize the tall book, while the tighter placement tolerance preserves the roughly 6.7 mm limiting insertion margin.

The failure was not grasp, transport, ordering, or predicate capability: it was a stochastic place-stage insertion/ejection, with all four trials timing out at place and init 2 ending outside the region. I retained the proven grasp, centered offset, yaw, lift, and transport settings; I raised place_dz from 0 to 0.04 so release occurs near the approximately 1.017 m height shared by all three successful outcomes, and tightened place_tol_m from 0.004 to 0.002 to reduce error within the narrow footprint margin.

The remaining failure was a place-stage lateral ejection, not a grasp, transport, order, height, or capability failure. I changed only target_offset_site.x from 0.00005 to -0.00995, biasing the commanded origin 10 mm away from the observed +X escape side. The observed trial-to-trial x-error envelope would then remain within the accepted origin box. The demonstrated grasp, yaw, heights, and minimum placement tolerance are unchanged because they produced successful grasps and three valid final placements.
